fixed: A record created on two devices under the same name, such as a choreographer, no longer asks you to choose between two identical versions after sync merges them, and a choice between differing versions of one is saved instead of failing with "The saved peer change is no longer current" whichever version you pick.

The merge no longer raises a conflict between copies of one record that differ only in an id merged away by natural-key reconciliation, and resolveConflicts accepts an offered version filed under the id it was merged into.
